published_observations.microscopy: HeLa cells; MitoTracker; Fig. 3A scrambled oligonucleotides for Yme1, Fig. 3G pan-Opa1 siRNA at 2 d, Fig. 3B Drp1 siRNA at 2 d. Panel A is the paper's scrambled comparator, not evidence of a separately matched Drp1-specific control experiment.
published_observations.drp1_observation: Results describe the increased connectivity of Yme1-siRNA mitochondria as strikingly similar to Drp1-siRNA morphology in Fig. 3B. This is published siRNA evidence, not a claim about the displayed JUMP knockout fields.
published_observations.reported_quantification: Results: 99% of cells transfected with Opa1 siRNA alone had fragmented mitochondria. This is the paper's reported value; no recount or new analysis.
published_observations.specificity_context: The paper distinguishes pan-Opa1 depletion from exon-specific siRNA and combined Opa1/Yme1 perturbations.
